exchanges: Good evening. I've just got back from the market and my arms are about to fall off.
Sounds like a big shop. Did you find everything you were after?
Mostly. The fruit stall was out of mangoes, which was disappointing.
That's a shame; maybe they'll restock by the weekend.
Hopefully. Our house is quiet tonight, Ana has shut herself in her room.
Quiet nights in a shared house are rare. Is she alright?
She will be. She gets a migraine every so often, a really bad one, and when it comes on she needs total darkness for a few hours.
That sounds miserable. Darkness and quiet is probably the kindest thing the rest of you can give her.
Yes, we all tiptoe around. Joon-ho made her some ginger tea.
That's sweet of him. It sounds like the house looks after each other.
We do, mostly. Joon-ho works from home as a translator, Korean to English, so he's usually around in the day.
That's handy for parcels and emergencies. Does he enjoy the work?
He says it's like solving puzzles all day. He has strong opinions about subtitles.
I'd imagine anyone in that line of work does. Bad subtitles must be painful to watch.
He pauses films to complain. It's quite funny.
Ha, that's dedication. Film nights must take a while.
They do. Anyway, Desmond next door came over to show off his new car.
Exciting. What did he get?
A Volvo estate, dark blue. He's very proud of it.
Sounds like a sensible, sturdy choice. Is he planning any road trips?
He wants to drive up to the Lake District. He's retired now; he was a postman for thirty years.
Thirty years of walking rounds, he's earned some time behind the wheel.
He definitely has. He knows everyone on the street because of it.
That kind of local knowledge is priceless. He must have great stories.
Endless stories. Oh, and the landlord, Mr Ferreira, is coming on Saturday with his wife.
Is it an inspection, or a social visit?
A bit of both. His wife is also called Ana, which confuses everyone. She's lovely but she has asthma, so we have to make sure nobody's been smoking in the garden.
Two Anas in one visit, that will be fun. Good of you to keep the air clear for her.
We try. Our housemate Callum smokes, so it's a constant battle.
That can be a tricky one. Maybe a designated spot well away from the house?
We've suggested the bottom of the garden. He grumbles but agrees.
Grumbling compliance is still compliance.
True. I'm thinking of getting dinner from Mulu's tonight. The Ethiopian place on the corner.
That sounds great after a long day. Do you have a favourite dish there?
Anything with her injera. She makes it fresh every morning, and it's the best I've had.
Freshly made bread like that makes all the difference. Sounds like a good choice for tonight.
Agreed. I'll order for Joon-ho as well, he loves it.
He'll appreciate that, especially after a day of puzzles.
I made a mistake earlier, by the way. Desmond's car isn't a Volvo. I just saw the badge properly, it's a Saab. I'd just assumed from the shape.
Easy mix-up from a distance, they do have a similar look. Swedish either way.
Ha, yes. He'd be offended if he knew I got it wrong.
Best kept between us, then.
Definitely. Callum's back now, he's making toast at nine at night.
A classic late-night snack. Hopefully he doesn't set the smoke alarm off.
He has done before, twice.
Then maybe stand near the alarm with a tea towel just in case.
Good idea. The food from Mulu's has arrived, I'll eat now.
Enjoy, it sounds like you've earned it.
It's delicious, as always.
Glad it lived up to expectations.
Joon-ho just told me he's signed up for a pottery class on Wednesday evenings. He wants something to do with his hands that isn't typing.
That's a nice balance to screen work. He might end up making everyone mugs.
He's already promised me a wonky bowl.
A handmade wonky bowl is better than a perfect shop one.
Agreed. I'm going to put my feet up now.
Sounds well deserved. Enjoy the rest of your evening.

questions.message: What's the health problem my housemate Ana has?
Remind me what Joon-ho's job is?
Desmond ended up with a Saab in the end, didn't he?
I think I'll have an early night and finish my book.
